Answer: B
Reason: The sequential chest X-rays demonstrate a progression from multifocal nodular opacities to extensive, diffuse bilateral fluffy infiltrates and consolidation. This radiographic pattern is characteristic of the diffuse pneumonic type of bronchioloalveolar carcinoma (now classified as invasive mucinous adenocarcinoma), which indicates aggressive multinodular disease with a poor prognosis.
